sentences.en: We should appeal to reason instead of resorting to violence.
sentences.zh: 我们应该诉诸理性而非 resorting to 暴力。

sentences.en: Maleness is by far the biggest risk factor for violence.
sentences.zh: 男性是暴力行为的最大风险因素。

sentences.en: These streets see more and more outbreaks of vigilante violence.
sentences.zh: 这些街道上越来越多地出现民愤爆发的暴力事件。

senses.zh: 暴力，强暴，暴虐,猛烈，激烈,歪曲（事实），曲解（意义）,冒渎，不敬
